title: ISO/IEC 18004 QR in Alphanumeric mode
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 10. Step 9 — Render the QR code; HCERT Specification, 4.2.2 QR 2D Barcode; ISO/IEC 18004:2015 QR Code.

statements.label: ISO/IEC 18004 QR in Alphanumeric mode
statements.requirement: The QR encoder SHALL produce an ISO/IEC 18004:2015 symbol carrying the whole HC1 string as Alphanumeric-mode (0010) data. It SHALL NOT fall back to byte mode, and SHALL fail if the input has characters outside the alphanumeric set.

sources.quote: The Alphanumeric (Mode 2/QR Code symbols 0010) MUST be used in conjunction with Base45.
